lines.zh: 嘶嘶地蠕动着庞大的身躯
lines.en: Slithering with immense bulk
Rumbles as it moves forward

lines.zh: 吐着信子感受周围的气息
lines.en: Tongue flicks to sense the air
Heavy footsteps echo
Grumbles in its throat

lines.zh: 张开大嘴露出锋利的牙齿
lines.en: Opens wide, showing sharp teeth

lines.zh: 缓慢地挪动着粗壮的四肢
lines.en: Slowly moving its massive legs
Crawls艰难地 through the rocks
Roars loudly
Flicks its tongue, seeking prey
Its tail sweeps a clump of dry grass aside.
Its claws slip on the sandstone.
It halts each step to sniff the ground.
Its back plates gleam grey in the sun.
It roots up a bush in its path.
Its heavy steps press shallow pits.

lines.zh: 我摊开肚皮，晒着台地的太阳。
lines.en: I sprawl belly-up under the mesa sun.
Slowly turning its eyes
Occasionally licks its scales
Quietly waiting for prey
Well fed. A roar helps digestion.
Slowly moving its tail

lines.zh: 偶尔发出轻微的嘶嘶声
lines.en: Occasionally hisses softly
Quietly staring into the distance
Gently yawns
Occasionally closes an eye
It rests its huge jaw on a rock.
Two puffs of dust leave its nostrils.
It scratches its neck with a hind claw.
It slowly closes its eyes in the shade.

lines.zh: 突然瞪大眼睛注视玩家
lines.en: Sudden widen its eyes at the player
Stares at the player, growling lowly

lines.zh: 注意到玩家后发出嘶嘶声
lines.en: Hisses when noticing the player
Stay away from my cubs.
Quickly turns to face the player

lines.zh: 盯着玩家发出震耳欲聋的咆哮
lines.en: Loud roar at the player
Threatening low growl
Alertly staring at the player
Opens wide, showing fangs
Warning hiss
Its pupils narrow into slits.
It tilts its head to your steps.
It smells no beetroot on you.
It parts its jaws, showing a broken tooth.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶声中，它摇晃着倒下。
lines.en: It staggers, hissing.

lines.zh: 巨大的身体在地上颤抖。
lines.en: Its massive body trembles.

lines.zh: 伤口从它皮下渗出血水。
lines.en: Blood soaks from its wounds.

lines.zh: 它摇摇欲坠，发出痛苦的咆哮。
lines.en: It roars in agony.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛黯淡无光，摇摇欲坠。
lines.en: Its eyes dim, swaying.

lines.zh: 它沉重地喘息着，身体摇晃。
lines.en: It labors, body quaking.

lines.zh: 它艰难地移动，鲜血直流。
lines.en: It struggles, blood streaming.
It gasps, groaning in pain.
It staggers, heavy-footed.
It backs off a step, blood on the sand.

lines.zh: 你离得太近了，噬颚兽咆哮着警告你。
lines.en: Eater roars a warning as you get too close.

lines.zh: 远处猎物的叫声引来噬颚兽的注意。
lines.en: The distant call of prey draws Eater’s attention.

lines.zh: 噬颚兽盯着地上的新鲜肉块，露出锋利的牙齿。
lines.en: Eater stares at the fresh meat, showing its sharp teeth.

lines.zh: 你手中的肉块吸引来了一只噬颚兽。
lines.en: A Eater approaches your meat block.

lines.zh: 它张开巨大的嘴巴，露出令人不安的牙齿。
lines.en: It opens its giant mouth, showing unsettling teeth.

lines.zh: 噬颚兽盯着你，似乎在考虑是否攻击。
lines.en: Eater watches you, considering an attack.

lines.zh: 它在你的肉块周围徘徊，似乎在做决定。
lines.en: It circles your meat, making a decision.

lines.zh: 你靠近它，它发出警告的咆哮。
lines.en: You approach, and it roars a warning.

lines.zh: 肉块吸引来了多只噬颚兽。
lines.en: Several Eaters are drawn to the meat.

lines.zh: 你试图靠近它，它咆哮起来。
lines.en: You try to approach, and it roars.
The smell of raw meat brings it to its feet.
A piece of meat draws it one step closer.

lines.zh: 你撞上了噬颚兽，它咆哮着反击。
lines.en: You collide with Eater, which roars back.

lines.zh: 巨大的噬颚兽在你面前出现，你退后几步。
lines.en: The giant Eater appears before you, and you step back.

lines.zh: 你试图穿过它，它阻挡了你的去路。
lines.en: You try to pass it, but it blocks your way.

lines.zh: 噬颚兽挡住了你的道路，发出低吼。
lines.en: Eater hurls a low growl, blocking your path.

lines.zh: 你试图绕过它，它发出了警告的咆哮。
lines.en: You try to bypass it, and it roars a warning.

lines.zh: 它挡住了你的去路，发出低沉的咆哮。
lines.en: It blocks your path, roaring lowly.

lines.zh: 你试图穿过它，但它发出警告。
lines.en: You try to pass, but it warns you.

lines.zh: 你撞上了它，它愤怒地咆哮。
lines.en: You collide with it, and it roars in anger.

lines.zh: 你试图绕过它，但它挡住了你的路。
lines.en: You try to bypass it, but it blocks your path.

lines.zh: 你试图接近它，但它发出警告。
lines.en: You try to approach it, but it warns you.

lines.zh: 噬颚兽发出求偶的咆哮声。
lines.en: Eater roars in mating call.

lines.zh: 两只噬颚兽在战斗中表现出求偶欲望。
lines.en: Two Eaters show mating desires in battle.

lines.zh: 噬颚兽发出求偶的低吼声。
lines.en: Eater emits a low mating growl.

lines.zh: 它向同类发出求偶的咆哮。
lines.en: It roars a mating call towards its kind.

lines.zh: 噬颚兽在求偶时发出沉闷的咆哮。
lines.en: Eater roars deep in mating.

lines.zh: 它发出了求偶的低吼声。
lines.en: It emits a low mating growl.

lines.zh: 两只噬颚兽互相发出求偶的咆哮。
lines.en: Two Eaters roar mating calls at each other.

lines.zh: 噬颚兽在求偶时发出深沉的咆哮。
lines.en: Eater roars deeply in mating.

lines.zh: 它们在求偶时互相咆哮。
lines.en: They roar at each other in mating.
They nuzzle necks behind the rocks.

lines.zh: 从地缝中钻出，威严地观察着四周。
lines.en: Emerges from cracks, surveying the surroundings with dignity.

lines.zh: 巨颚张合，发出低沉的回响。
lines.en: Jaw opens and closes, resonating a deep echo.

lines.zh: 啃食动物尸体，享受猎物的味道。
lines.en: Feasts on carcasses, savoring the taste of prey.

lines.zh: 幼崽哭泣，引来附近猎食者的注意。
lines.en: Young whimpers, drawing attention from nearby predators.

lines.zh: 在古老遗迹中孵化，逐渐长大。
lines.en: Hatches in ancient ruins, growing larger.
Chews on prey, making crunching noises.

lines.zh: 巨大颚骨闭合，震慑猎物。
lines.en: Large jaw closes, intimidating prey.

lines.zh: 靠近幼崽，警惕地注视着。
lines.en: Cautiously watching over the young ones.

lines.zh: 探索新环境，寻找食物来源。
lines.en: Exploring new environments, seeking food sources.

lines.zh: 在岩缝中藏匿，等待时机出击。
lines.en: Hides in rock crevices, waiting for the right moment to strike.
Locks onto target, eyes blazing.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶声响起，表明捕食意图。
lines.en: Hissing indicates predatory intent.
Opens wide jaw, ready to hunt.

lines.zh: 注意到了一个脆弱的目标。
lines.en: Detects a vulnerable target.

lines.zh: 幼崽受到威胁，咆哮警告。
lines.en: Young ones threatened, roaring a warning.
My jaws part, and I roar first.

lines.zh: 锁定最近的目标，准备吞食。
lines.en: Targeting nearest, ready to consume.

lines.zh: 猎杀目标，享受捕食的快感。
lines.en: Hunting target, enjoying the hunt.

lines.zh: 幼崽受到攻击，凶猛反击。
lines.en: Young ones反击猛烈， fiercely retaliate.

lines.zh: 捕食者逼近，它准备好了。
lines.en: Predator approaches, it’s ready.
It recognizes the pillager.
It pushes the cub behind it.

lines.zh: 幼崽被攻击，发出尖锐叫声。
lines.en: Young cry out in distress.

lines.zh: 幼崽躲在母体身后，寻求保护。
lines.en: Young hide behind mother for protection.
Young scream in fear.

lines.zh: 幼崽惊恐地哭泣，寻求帮助。
lines.en: Young cry in terror, seeking help.

lines.zh: 幼崽被攻击，母体凶猛护子。
lines.en: Mother fiercely protects young from attack.
Young cry, mother tense.

lines.zh: 幼崽被攻击，母体嘶吼警告。
lines.en: Mother roars a warning at attackers.

lines.zh: 幼崽被攻击，母体疯狂反击。
lines.en: Mother fiercely retaliates against attackers.
Young protected, mother alert.

lines.zh: 幼崽受到保护，母体咆哮威慑。
lines.en: Young protected, mother roars a warning.
It lowers its body to charge.
Its roar carries a note of dread.
It aims at the rim of your shield.

lines.zh: 低吼震山林，獠牙闪烁亮。
lines.en: Rumble shakes the forest, fangs gleam bright.
Charge at the raider, fury burning in heart.
Cub's cry stirs rage within.
Shield crumbles like tofu, battle rage boiling.
Grating sound of bone, echoing through the valley.
Meat-eating beast, life and death in its grasp.
Eggs in the temple ruins.
Attacks only for young or prey too close.
Eater's tooth, ancient relic.
Untamable, lone hunter.
The jaws close and the shield splits.
A broken tooth rakes your leggings.
Hatchling emerges, new Eater.
Ruined temple, giant hatches here.
Rock below, ancient eggs.
Carnivorous, hunts for food.
Raider near, danger awaits.
Cub's cry, draws the father out.
Ancient creature, neutral spirit.
Fear only young, nothing else.
Eater's tooth, for archaeologists.
Untamable, child of nature.
The eggshell cracks on the altar.
A dull thud echoes in the temple.
The cub pushes off the shell and stands.
A great shape joins the dust.
Flames lick its flesh.

lines.zh: 它重重摔在地上，骨骼断裂。
lines.en: It crashes, bones breaking.

lines.zh: 它在水中挣扎，喘不过气来。
lines.en: It gasps, struggling in water.

lines.zh: 强烈的冲击波撕裂它的皮肤。
lines.en: The blast rips its skin.
An arrow pierces its flesh.

lines.zh: 魔法之力侵蚀着它的肌肉。
lines.en: Magic sears its flesh.
It's emaciated, weak.
Lightning rips its flesh.

lines.zh: 它在虚空之中无声倒下。
lines.en: It falls silent in the void.
